verdict.rationale: A design editor could plausibly ship a plugin API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no plugin API, typings, samples, or way to distribute editor extensions. The items it does show are adjacent and earn no credit: imports, exports, Claude Code handoff and /design-sync, app connectors, and a community MCP flow into PenPot.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented plugin API with typings and samples lets me build and distribute my own editor extensions
